{{Top}}
Within most organized [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] armed forces, '''flight leader''' referred to the officer in a position of authority over a squads (or [[Flight group/Legends|flights]]) of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], or other aerial military formations. The [[Beast Riders]], warriors who hailed from the jungle wilderness of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], employed flight leaders in direct command of [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of Beast Riders, which were known as "wings". During the [[Beast Wars]], they were tasked by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gobee]] to continue their [[Raid on the Iziz Royal Palace|assault]] on the [[Iziz defense tower|defensive battlements]] of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]], the capital city of Onderon. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] was a flight leader within the ranks of the renowned [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]].
